title: MX rendering repairs after visual acceptance
summary: Initial import checks showed the MX venues loaded, but visual acceptance was insufficient: selector previews lost opacity, nearby foliage looked cut out, and MX skies showed an edge seam. Focused repairs have now been merged for those three defects.
details: Preview opacity (#677, 35d219c1): restored the original full 280 photos and corrected GS alpha 128 to UI alpha 255. All 56 mobile selector cases passed; the application carrying this fix was observed live.

Foliage (#678, b43ae6a9): adjusted the MX near-foliage alpha threshold margin while preserving the ATV2 path. Original and Remastered captures were inspected on the exact artifact; this is host verification.

Sky (#687, 6fcd51f7): MX sky UVs now use unpadded edges while ATV2 keeps its inset. Exact-artifact run 43668172056 passed focused The Glades sky 97 and NAT01 sky 28 tests. Four horizons and the zenith were matched in Original and Remastered; five ATV2 control images remained byte-identical. Host captures before and after were inspected.
limitation: The sky repair is merged but public deployment was not confirmed when this checkpoint was recorded. Ground softness, a dark terrain card and a stretched banner remain under active repair. Native LOD, weather and reflections remain incomplete; no physical-phone visual acceptance was performed. This is not full MX rendering parity.
caption: Host capture of The Glades near foliage after the MX alpha-threshold repair; terrain presentation still needs work.
